title: A blockwise separable ball depends only on the smaller compression dimension
statement_preview_not_a_proof: Every integers s,b>=1 and Hermitian E on C^s tensor C^b with ||E||op<=eps<=1/(2s-1). I+E is separable independently of b. For the candidate W=I-32G with q_r(G)<=1/(64r), every complex first-factor isometric compression to s<=r is separable;
